gloss: to have no room; to have no time or money to spare

definitions.gloss: to have no room; to have no leeway; to be pressed for time, money, or capacity
definitions.explanation: Expresses a lack of spare time, money, mental capacity, or physical space. Often used to explain why one cannot take on additional tasks or obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない。
examples.english: I don't have any room right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I have no time for hobbies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない。
examples.english: I've had so many expenses this month that I can't afford to travel.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧ means "margin," "leeway," or "room to spare." The expression {余裕|よゆう}がない indicates a complete lack of spare capacity in any dimension — time, money, energy, or emotional bandwidth. It is a very common and natural way to decline invitations or explain one's constraints.

The positive form ⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ means to have plenty of room or time to spare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない (to have no spare time)
- ⟦{金銭的|きんせんてき}→金銭的：21897_kinsenteki⟧な{余裕|よゆう}がない (to have no financial leeway)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない (to have no emotional room)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余裕|よゆう}がない (to be mentally overwhelmed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no free time — more specific to time
- {手一杯|ていっぱい}: to have one's hands full — emphasizes being at capacity with tasks
